title: 日常起居
prompt_en: Describe your morning with irregular verbs.
prompt_zh: 用不规则动词描述你的早晨。
description: 起床、吃喝、坐立、放置、开关的高频不规则动词
knowledge_points: wake→woke→woken, get→got→got, eat→ate→eaten, drink→drank→drunk, sit→sat→sat, stand→stood→stood, lie→lay→lain, lay→laid→laid, put→put→put, set→set→set, shut→shut→shut, light→lit→lit, feed→fed→fed, bite→bit→bitten, sleep→slept→slept
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 16 个日常起居动词，AAA（put/set/shut）+ ABB（get/sleep/sit/stand/lay/light/feed）+ ABC（wake/eat/drink/lie/bite），注意 lie/lay 辨析。

title: 来去与移动
prompt_en: Tell a travel story with past forms.
prompt_zh: 用过去式讲述一次出行经历。
description: 来、去、离开、带领、骑、驾驶、飞、游泳、落下、下沉、传播
knowledge_points: go→went→gone, come→came→come, become→became→become, rise→rose→risen, arise→arose→arisen, leave→left→left, lead→led→led, fall→fell→fallen, ride→rode→ridden, drive→drove→driven, fly→flew→flown, swim→swam→swum, slide→slid→slid, leap→leapt→leapt, speed→sped→sped, sink→sank→sunk, spread→spread→spread
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 17 个移动动词，ABA（come/become）+ ABB（leave/lead/slide/speed/sink/spread）+ ABC（go/rise/arise/ride/drive/fly/swim/fall/leap）。

title: 感知与思考
description: 看、听、感觉、知道、思考、理解、忘记、学习、教、读、写、找到
knowledge_points: see→saw→seen, hear→heard→heard, smell→smelt→smelt, feel→felt→felt, know→knew→known, think→thought→thought, understand→understood→understood, mean→meant→meant, forget→forgot→forgotten, learn→learnt→learnt, teach→taught→taught, read→read→read, write→wrote→written, spell→spelt→spelt, dream→dreamt→dreamt, find→found→found
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 16 个感官心智动词，AAA（read）+ ABB（hear/feel/think/understand/learn/spell/find/teach）+ ABC（see/know/forget/write/dream/mean）。

title: 说话与沟通
prompt_zh: 转述一次你参与的对话。
description: 说、告诉、讲、唱、响铃、广播、发送、带来、展示、遇见、给予、握住、承受
knowledge_points: say→said→said, tell→told→told, speak→spoke→spoken, sing→sang→sung, ring→rang→rung, broadcast→broadcast→broadcast, swear→swore→sworn, forbid→forbade→forbidden, forgive→forgave→forgiven, send→sent→sent, bring→brought→brought, show→showed→shown, meet→met→met, give→gave→given, hold→held→held, bear→bore→borne
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 16 个言语沟通动词，ABB（say/tell/send/bring/hold/meet）+ ABC（speak/sing/ring/forgive/forbid/bear/swear）+ AAA（broadcast）。

title: 金钱与交易
description: 买、卖、付、花费、借出、拿、偷、打赌、处理、放弃、选择、赢、输、赚
knowledge_points: buy→bought→bought, sell→sold→sold, pay→paid→paid, cost→cost→cost, spend→spent→spent, lend→lent→lent, take→took→taken, steal→stole→stolen, bet→bet→bet, deal→dealt→dealt, quit→quit→quit, choose→chose→chosen, win→won→won, lose→lost→lost, make→made→made
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 15 个交易动词，AAA（cost/bet）+ ABB（buy/sell/pay/spend/lend/win/lose/make/deal/quit）+ ABC（take/steal/choose）。

title: 运动与比赛
description: 跑、扔、接住、击打、打败、战斗、投篮、击球、摆动、旋转、躲藏、悬挂
knowledge_points: run→ran→run, throw→threw→thrown, catch→caught→caught, hit→hit→hit, beat→beat→beaten, fight→fought→fought, shoot→shot→shot, strike→struck→struck, swing→swung→swung, spin→spun→spun, hide→hid→hidden, hang→hung→hung
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 12 个竞技动词，AAA（hit）+ ABA（run）+ AAB（beat）+ ABB（catch/fight/shoot/strike/swing/spin/hang）+ ABC（throw/hide）。

title: 身体与意外
prompt_en: Describe an accident to a doctor.
description: 受伤、流血、烫伤、割伤、折断、蜇、爆裂、吐、裂开、撕破、结冰、缩水、弯腰、跪下、倚靠、发抖、洒出
knowledge_points: hurt→hurt→hurt, bleed→bled→bled, burn→burnt→burnt, cut→cut→cut, break→broke→broken, sting→stung→stung, burst→burst→burst, spit→spat→spat, split→split→split, tear→tore→torn, freeze→froze→frozen, shrink→shrank→shrunk, bend→bent→bent, kneel→knelt→knelt, lean→leant→leant, shake→shook→shaken, spill→spilt→spilt
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 17 个身体意外动词，AAA（hurt/cut/burst/split/spit）+ ABB（bleed/burn/bend/kneel/lean/shake/spill/sting）+ ABC（break/freeze/shrink/tear）。

title: 拥有与创造
prompt_zh: 介绍一个你制作的作品。
description: 有、保持、让、建造、画画、成长、吹、挖掘、捆绑、穿戴、粘住、照耀、缠绕、开始、变坏
knowledge_points: have→had→had, keep→kept→kept, let→let→let, build→built→built, draw→drew→drawn, grow→grew→grown, blow→blew→blown, dig→dug→dug, bind→bound→bound, wear→wore→worn, stick→stuck→stuck, be→was,were→been, do→did→done, begin→began→begun, sweep→swept→swept, shine→shone→shone, wind→wound→wound, spoil→spoilt→spoilt
teaching_markdown: 本话题覆盖 18 个拥有创造动词，含超特殊 be/do/have，AAA（let）+ ABB + ABC。
